_doc: Calibration views per camera (tools/cameras/ptz.py, tools/mission/calibrate.py). home = the show position the camera always returns to (preset id on the camera, and its pan/tilt in the camera's own units, from `ptz.py <cam> pos`). views = where a calibration photographs the lights, in order; the first must be home. pan/tilt: units, "max"/"min" (drive to the stop) or left out (home's). Neighbouring views must overlap (the lights both see are how they're stitched). tol = units a position may be off.
